dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Jelajahi urutan jahitan, warna benang, lompatan, potongan, dan perintah mesin sebelum produksi. Pratinjau desain jahitan demi jahitan, ganti gaya rendering, dan ekspor apa yang Anda lihat.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Simulasi bordir interaktif, inspeksi, dan ekspor.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Tempelkan penggaris pada layar dan seret penggeser hingga batang di bawah tepat 100 mm, lalu tekan OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Salin gambar resolusi penuh ke clipboard

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Bahasa telah diatur ke {language}. Restart InkSim sekarang untuk menerapkannya?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Bahasa default sistem akan digunakan. Restart InkSim sekarang untuk menerapkannya?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Semua jendela InkSim yang terbuka akan ditutup dan berkas saat ini dibuka kembali.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Buka SVG ini di jendela Inkscape baru.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Tidak ada file yang didukung di folder ini.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Klik dua kali folder untuk menelusuri file di dalamnya.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Klik dua kali folder untuk menelusuri file di dalamnya.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape diperlukan untuk mengedit file SVG.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Instalasi Ink/Stitch yang sudah dikonfigurasi dan peluncur Python diperlukan.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Buat data jahitan dari SVG ini dengan Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Tidak dapat menjalankan skrip Ink/Stitch yang aktif atau peluncur Python yang dikonfigurasi.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Ekstensi Ink/Stitch: tidak dapat diperiksa. Gunakan Alat... untuk mencoba lagi.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Ekstensi Ink/Stitch: tidak ditemukan di direktori ekstensi Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Ekstensi Ink/Stitch: tidak dapat diperiksa sebelum Inkscape dikonfigurasi.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Ekstensi Ink/Stitch: belum diperiksa. Gunakan Alat... untuk memeriksa.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Sumber SVG. Inkscape diperlukan untuk pratinjau jahitan.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Sumber SVG. Pilih Pratinjau untuk membuat data jahitan dengan Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: SVG ini terlalu besar untuk dipratinjau di sini.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Tidak dapat membuat file pratinjau sementara: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Jenis file ini tidak dapat dibuka di InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Tidak dapat menyimpan status ekstensi Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Tidak dapat memeriksa folder ekstensi Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_user_current.translation: Ekstensi pengguna saat ini (target instalasi/pembaruan): {path} | Status: {status}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Tidak dapat menginstal ekstensi Inkscape InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Ekstensi Inkscape InkSim telah diinstal atau diperbarui di {path}. Mulai ulang Inkscape untuk memuatnya.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape tidak ditemukan di jalur sistem.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Tidak dapat membaca direktori ekstensi Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Mulai ulang Inkscape untuk menerapkan interpreter Python yang baru.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Tidak dapat menghapus folder ekstensi InkSim lama: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Folder ekstensi InkSim lama telah dihapus. Mulai ulang Inkscape untuk memuat ulang daftar ekstensinya.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Konfigurasi InkSim telah menyimpan pengaturan yang terdeteksi.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Tidak dapat memeriksa folder ekstensi Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Peluncur yang diperlukan '{command}' tidak ditemukan; preferensi tidak diubah.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape tidak ditemukan. Pilih executable-nya untuk memeriksa pengaturan.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Tidak dapat memeriksa atau memperbarui interpreter Python: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Preferensi interpreter Python tidak diperiksa karena direktori ekstensi pengguna tidak tersedia.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Mulai ulang Inkscape untuk menerapkan interpreter yang diperbarui.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Pilih executable Inkscape untuk memeriksa pengaturan.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape tidak merespons dalam {seconds} detik. Instans Inkscape lain atau ekstensi mungkin menghambat komunikasi. Tutup instans Inkscape lain atau nonaktifkan ekstensi yang menghambat, lalu coba lagi.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Peluncur yang diperlukan '{command}' tidak ditemukan. Instal alat uvr sendiri dengan `uv tool install uvr`, lalu jalankan konfigurasi ini lagi. InkSim tidak akan menginstalnya.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Tidak ada berkas bordir yang dimuat untuk diekspor.

message.no_file_to_save.translation: Tidak ada berkas bordir yang dimuat.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Atur ulang lebar garis dan faktor bayangan

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Klik untuk menyesuaikan faktor gelap, faktor terang, dan lebar garis

status.mode.background.translation: Siklus latar belakang: hitam, putih, terkonfigurasi

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Tampilan bawah (gambar jahitan kemudian di bawah yang sebelumnya)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Siklus tampilan lompatan: mati, semua, hanya berisiko
